Phase 3 implementation planner pass — Dendro R1 Amendment 1.
Goal /home/sam/code/dendro; previous architecture pass transitions/0005.json independently read. Actual branch work/dendro-r1; worktree /home/sam/code/dendro/.worktrees/work/dendro-r1, created from full commit d724204d5ab1872bb38b42e4864123ebb7e00958. Sole writer dev.build-sr. No primary-clone code edits.
Frozen brief: .worktrees/work/dendro-r1/.agent-runs/inputs/dendro-r1/IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md SHA256 ecfcc792f250472bdac70007e8f9d2d6d472c96b212e0c8eecf3dbd663229651. Frozen acceptance digest 046c172214a93eaefc1666dc0f0234ffa0e606880afa93e6881e45d3108fae3e. Input manifest beside brief includes every product/architecture/oracle digest. Root dirty product artifacts preserved; frozen copies are task inputs, not generated files to commit.
Files and order: core typed models/traits/versioned storage, privacy/provenance/generation modules; connector discovery and OpenRig/Claude/Codex/Pi ingestion; identity resolver and historical ownership; numeric analytics/trace; CLI run/report/trace with root overrides and loop flags; required Cargo manifests/lock and CLI documentation/synthetic fixtures. Full file/interface/test detail in frozen brief. Watcher/Nao/site and guessed AGY/Grok parsers out of scope. Project-scoped dependencies only; safe Rust workspace; no source DB changes or migrations.
Pre-code architectural council concurrence and implementation-plan critique recorded: reviewer qitem-20261010171301-2257b485, QA qitem-20261010171249-d070d0a4, builder qitem-20261010171919-e3d3c453 plus preceding architecture receipts in Phase2. All structural findings have explicit dispositions in brief. Freeze five-crate separation, snapshot traces, keyed exact lexical equality, opaque identity versus redacted display, new-only R1 schema, no guessing/currency invention, one canonical usage/activity stream.
Mechanism entry evidence: builder reports checkpoint/close removes DuckDB staging WAL, read-only open of staged valid DB, alias hazard, rename/no-replace source-target protection and serde RawValue lexical preservation. Original C probes later crash; architect source inspection found unchecked failed opens/handle use, so crashes are not a proven DuckDB defect. Evidence is scoped pre-code feasibility testimony, not candidate tests. Candidate safe Rust lifecycle must exit successfully and prove all refusal/crash cases. Frozen SQLite byte-copies the source trio and reads private copy mode=ro to preserve hashes and WAL records; live SQLite mode=ro only, permitted SHM exception. Exact mappings: Codex input inclusive of cache and cumulative one-stream deltas/reset; Claude/Pi exclusive four buckets; reasoning subset, no additive total/cache object.
Output protects sources through private staging, anchored no-follow operations and atomic main-file publication after checkpoint/close. Separate output-side advisory lock spans preflight through publish; refuse active existing output WAL and concurrent writers. Immutable key continuity, exclusive key-first new publication, orphan-key recovery/refusal, old-or-new DB atomic state and schema key-id match are mandatory tests. Residual same-user ancestor relocation not represented as an absolute guarantee. No publication operation may follow a destination link to write source bytes.
QA selected Python standard-library ptrace observer; availability smoke reported successful, full policy/descendant/fd/mmap/network negative controls are QA work after Phase4 and before acceptance. Not an acceptance proof now. AC1 is untraced <=300sec ingest+first report; AC2-AC12 exact independent oracles in frozen oracle matrix. Automated commands: cargo check --workspace; cargo test --workspace; cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings; cargo fmt --check. Phase4 return includes full candidate commit, exact commands/results, CLI interface, tests and known limitations. Phase5 dev.qa runs independently, then Phase6 rev.review; orch owns 7/8. If implementation refutes plan, record return to Phase3, no silent scope change.
Workflow high-assurance; user-authorized autonomous/zero-human-blocking posture retained, generic human-gated classifier result recorded honestly and not used to downgrade assurance. Independent QA/review/all phases mandatory. No push, PR, merge or release publication authorized. Use configured machine git identity only. Do not commit .agent-runs artifacts or raw personal logs. Sponsor O8 decision remains a separate pending human value observation, never synthesized as a pass.
